{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Web GUI theme studio: presets + per-mode customization (accent, background, foreground, fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast) via the official webServer.tapIndex seam","id":"gh:1334352110","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-theme-plugin","slug":"BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin","topics":["ai-agent","coding-agent","deepseek","dsh-plugin","javascript","plugin","theme"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Web GUI theme studio: presets + per-mode customization (accent, background, foreground, fonts, t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ranslucent sidebar, contrast) via the official webServer.tapIndex seam"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-theme-plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English · 简体中文**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable l"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ight/dark palettes — accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar and cont"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rast — applied instantly, with no page refresh."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 🎨 **5 built-in presets** — `codex-warm`, `nord`, `solarized`, `graphite`, plus the stock DeepSeek "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"theme
- 🖌️ **Full customization** — per-mode (`light.*` / `dark.*`) accent, background, foreground, "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"UI font, code font, translucent sidebar and contrast; `custom` mode starts from scratch
- ⚡ **Instan"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"t hot-swap** — a Settings GUI ("Theme Studio") applies changes immediately through the official `ctx"},{"id":"p6s5","text":".theme.overrideTokens` API; light/dark follow the system preference
- 💾 **Persistent** — the selecti"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"on is saved in browser `localStorage` and survives reloads
- 🧮 **70+ derived tokens** — three colors"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" plus a contrast value expand into the whole semantic token set (borders, layers, scrollbar, tooltip"},{"id":"p6s8","text":", code blocks, bubbles, sidebar states…)
- 🪟 **Translucent sidebar** — real frosted sidebar via the "},{"id":"p6s9","text":"`--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` variable
- 🔌 **Official seams only** — host-side injection through `we"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"bServer.tapIndex`, no patched vendor files"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness with the web profile enabled. Install from the official registry:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` for the plugin to take effect."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"To remove:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Settings GUI (recommended)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"After a restart, open **Settings → Theme Studio**:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Preset** — one-click chips: DeepSeek default / Codex warm / Nord / Solarized / Graphite / Custom"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"
- **Colors** — color pickers for accent, background and foreground, with a "follow preset" reset
- "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"**Fonts** — dropdowns for the UI font and the code font (common stacks included)
- **Translucent sid"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ebar** — follow preset / on / off
- **Contrast** — slider 0–100 with preset restore"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Every change applies instantly and persists locally; GUI selections take priority over host config."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> The `stock` preset derives no palette: color controls are disabled and only fonts can be overridde"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"The `stock` preset derives no palette: color controls are disabled and only fonts can be overridden."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Config reference"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Field | Type | Description |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `preset` | enum | `stock` · `codex-warm` · `nord` · `solarized` · `graphite` · `custom` (default `"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"codex-warm`) |
| `light.accent` | color | accent for light mode (primary buttons, links, …) |
| `lig"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ht.background` | color | light-mode background |
| `light.foreground` | color | light-mode primary t"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ext |
| `light.uiFont` | CSS `font-family` | UI font stack |
| `light.codeFont` | CSS `font-family` "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"| code font stack |
| `light.translucentSidebar` | enum | `preset` · `on` · `off` |
| `light.contras"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"t` | number | 0–100; `-1` = keep preset value |
| `dark.*` | — | same fields for dark mode |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Empty strings mean "keep the preset value"; unset fields are not overridden at all."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Example — merge into the web profile patch (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Only set the fields you want to change; leave the rest blank (`''` / `preset` / `-1`)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Presets"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Preset | Style | Light bg / fg / accent | Dark bg / fg / accent |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `stock` | DeepSeek default | — (no override) | — (no override) |
| `codex-warm` | Codex warm | `#F"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"5F3EE` / `#1D1B16` / `#DA7756` | `#2D2D2B` / `#F9F9F7` / `#CC7D5E` |
| `nord` | Nord cool | `#ECEFF4"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"` / `#2E3440` / `#5E81AC` | `#2E3440` / `#ECEFF4` / `#88C0D0` |
| `solarized` | Solarized | `#FDF6E3"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"` / `#657B83` / `#B58900` | `#002B36` / `#839496` / `#268BD2` |
| `graphite` | Grayscale minimal | `"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"#FAFAFA` / `#171717` / `#525252` | `#171717` / `#FAFAFA` / `#A3A3A3` |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`custom` starts from the `codex-warm` palette and takes every value from `light.*` / `dark.*`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Host half** (`index.js`) — registers a `webServer.tapIndex` hook so every served `index.html` ge"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ts a `<style>` block injected before `</head>`, after the stylesheet links, letting the overrides wi"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"n by cascade order. This is the same official seam the built-in UI theme uses.
- **Specificity** — s"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"electors are written as `html body` / `html body[data-ds-dark-theme]` to outrank the theme's static "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"CSS variables.
- **Token derivation** — from background / foreground / accent plus a contrast factor"},{"id":"p31s6","text":", a small functional engine derives 70+ semantic tokens (border levels, layers, scrollbar, tooltip, "},{"id":"p31s7","text":"markdown code blocks, bubbles, sidebar states…). Status colors (success / error / warn) keep their s"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"tock meaning.
- **Translucent sidebar** — `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` is emitted as `rgba(mix(bg, "},{"id":"p31s9","text":"fg, 3%), 0.65)` when enabled; AppFrame / SidebarRoot / WorkspaceBrowser / TrajectoryTable consume th"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"at variable directly.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) — a web-shell module that registers a "Theme S"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"tudio" section under Settings and writes every change via `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`; the theme pres"},{"id":"p31s12","text":"enter emits the tokens inline on `<body>`, so the effect is instant and survives until the next sele"},{"id":"p31s13","text":"ction. Selections persist in `localStorage`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (`dsh web`)

- Issues: <https://github.com/BeiZi6/dsh-"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"theme-plugin/issues>"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## 中文简介"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 打造的主题工作室插件:5 套内置预设(Codex 暖色 / Nord / Solarized / Graphite / 默认)+ 完全"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"自定义;设置页内热切换、立即生效并持久化;通过官方 `webServer.tapIndex` 接缝向 index.html 注入主题 CSS,由背景/前景/强调三色与对比度函数式推导 70+ 语义令牌"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"、立即生效并持久化;通过官方 `webServer.tapIndex` 接缝向 index.html 注入主题 CSS,由背景/前景/强调三色与对比度函数式推导 70+ 语义令牌,并支持半透明侧边栏。"}],"truncated":false}
